<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex034052026-11-1301-32-50" status="reviewed">
             <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon 2 (91a2-91a3)"/>
            <lg><l><expan>thams cad</expan> mkhyen pa mchog la brtson 'grus go bgos shing ||</l> 
            <l>blo gros 'od zer 'bar bas don rnams legs gsal dang ||</l> 
            <l>rgyal <lb n="91a3"/> sras blo'i nor can gzhon nu'i tshul ||</l> 
            <l>chos kyi seng ges legs rtogs skrag mdzad pa ||</l><note type="editorial">These verses seem to refer to the author's teacher gZhon nu seng ge (ID:3946) and  Bya 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus 'bar (ID:3818)</note> </lg>
            <lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3946">dam pa de 2</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3818">dag</rs> gi gzhung gsal phyir ||</l> 
            <l>sgro skur bral ba'i tshig gis legs bkod 'di' ||</l> 
            <l>bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bslab 3 'dzin byed pa'i ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3969">chos kyi dbang phyug</rs> zhes byar grags pas sbyar ||  </l></lg>
            yi+T ||</seg></TEI>
source: 2_034_05_ Chos kyi dbang phyug _ rtsa ba'i lung so sor thar pa'i TIk+ka legs par bkod pa.xml
